messages:
oncall-jamie: Pager fired - multiple 5xxs for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error rate ~18% for the past 2m. Paging now.

sre-bot: ALERT: gen-service-usw-5xx-rate > 10% for 120s. Incident ID: INC-2026-0421. Pager routed to oncall-jamie.

oncall-jamie: I'm looking. traced a spike to backend pool fastgen-gpu-3 hitting OOMs. Noticed node restarts.

alice-prodeng: Confirmed OOMs on host gpu-3-2, KV cache pressure + long requests from a small customer load.

oncall-jamie: Quick mitigation: disable large-batch routing for fastgen for now, and scale up dedicated fallback pool. I'll draft status page.

raj-ops: I'll spin up 2x fallback instances in dedicated pool and add routing rule to send traffic to fastgen-v1-fallback. ETA ~4m.

oncall-jamie: thx. can someone draft an initial customer-facing status page blurb? short + clear. @maria-comm?

maria-comm: On it. Drafting now. keeping it concise.

maria-comm: DRAFT: "We are investigating increased error rates for text generation in US-West. Some requests may return 5xx errors or experience increased latency. Our engineers are mitigating and traffic is being routed to fallback capacity. We will share updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall-jamie: Good. Add note: "No data loss reported; requests may need retry."

maria-comm: Updated DRAFT -> "We are investigating increased error rates for text generation in US‑West (us-west-2). Some requests may return 5xx errors or see increased latency. Traffic is being routed to fallback capacity; retries are recommended. No data loss has been detected. Updates every 15 minutes."

legal-bot: Please avoid implying SLAs or guaranteed timelines. "Investigating" + "updates every 15 minutes" is fine.

maria-comm: ack. leaving interval but removing any promise of ETA.

oncall-jamie: Raj - status on fallback routing?

raj-ops: Fallback pool up, routing rule in place. Traffic shifted ~60% to fallback. Error rate dropped to ~6% in last 30s. Still seeing occasional 5xx from a handful of pods.

alice-prodeng: I have a patch to reduce KV cache pressure and a rolling restart plan for the affected hosts. Will coordinate with Raj to avoid thrash.

oncall-jamie: OK. Maria, please post initial status page note now. After publish, ping customers with the same short blurb in customer-status channel.

maria-comm: Publishing status page now. Copy below for verification: 

```
Incident: Increased error rate for text generation - US-West (us-west-2)
Impact: Some customers may experience 5xx errors or increased latency for text generation requests to the hosted API.
Scope: ~18% of requests at peak; currently reduced to ~6% after routing to fallback.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback capacity; engineers are restarting affected hosts and applying config to reduce KV cache pressure.
Customer action: Retries are recommended.
ETA: Investigating. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
```

maria-comm: ready to publish?

oncall-jamie: go ahead. I'll tag the incident ticket and include notes about mitigation steps.

maria-comm: Published to status page. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0421

raj-ops: Routing working, error rate holding ~4-6%. Fallback pool handling load fine.

alice-prodeng: Started rolling restart on 3 affected hosts with config tweak. No regressions so far.

oncall-jamie: Good. Next update in 15m with current metrics and whether we can restore normal routing.

maria-comm: Noted. I'll push update in 15m. Also preparing customer-facing email template if this extends.

15m-later oncall-jamie: Update: error rate stabilized at ~3.2%. We are continuing rollouts. No customer-visible data loss. Planning to reintroduce normal routing in a canary to 10% in 30m.

maria-comm: UPDATE published: "Error rate reduced after routing to fallback and host restarts. Engineers will canary returning traffic to main pool at 10% in 30m; we'll post results."

legal-bot: Reminder: if any customers ask for incident timeline, include host IDs + actions taken. Keep logs for audit.

oncall-jamie: copy. logging notes in INC ticket.

raj-ops: Canary started to 10% at +30m. Monitoring KPIs.

alice-prodeng: Canary looking good at 10% for 10m. CPU & memory stable, KV cache hits back to normal.

oncall-jamie: Increasing canary to 40%.

raj-ops: Canary to 40% done. Error rate across the board now ~1%.

maria-comm: FINAL/RESOLVE draft: "Resolved: The increased error rate impacting text generation in US‑West has been mitigated. Traffic has been gradually returned to normal pools. If you continue to see errors, please contact support with request IDs. We will post a detailed post-incident report." Approve?

oncall-jamie: Approve.

legal-bot: Approved for public post.

maria-comm: Published resolved notice and closed the status page incident entry. Resolved timestamp: 1749876620.

oncall-jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll write a short postmortem with timeline and remediation actions later today. :white_check_mark:"
